import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        int l = s.length();
        System.out.print(s.charAt(0));
        int sign = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < l; i++) {
            if (i != l - 3 && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i+1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i+2) == 't') {
                System.out.print(".");
                i += 2;
            } else if (i != l - 2 && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i+1) == 't' && sign == 0) {
                System.out.print("@");
                i += 1;
                sign = 1;
            } else {
                System.out.print(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
